caption: The drawing depicts a single large, round pot or cauldron resting on three small legs. The pot has two handles attached on opposite sides near the rim, and its surface is divided into horizontal bands by subtle ridges. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black using what appears to be pencil or charcoal, with shading on the left and beneath the pot to suggest shadow and give the image a three-dimensional effect. The background is a light beige or cream color, with faint vertical and horizontal lines suggesting a simple wall or surface behind and beneath the cauldron. The entire drawing is centered on a slightly darker rectangular area surrounded by a wider, lighter border. A signature and date appear in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Iron Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
